summary.text: Roger Brabandt is the Republican candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 5 in the House from 2010 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Roger Brabandt earned a B.S. from Minot State University and worked as a branch manager for Fargo Paint & Glass of Minot.

Brabandt took office in the North Dakota House of Representatives on December 1, 2010, after winning the November 2010 general election alongside Scott Louser over incumbent Democrat Louis Pinkerton and Heidi Rintoul.
He was re-elected in 2014 and left office on November 30, 2018, having not filed for re-election that year.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Energy and Natural Resources and Judiciary from 2011 through 2015, and Appropriations in 2017.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
